# SEC Filing Report: Apple Inc. (AAPL)

**Last 30 days** · 18 filings (4 x14, 144 x4) · 3 primary documents read in full · 9 ownership forms parsed

---

## SNAPSHOT

Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193, Nasdaq: AAPL, SIC Electronic Computers, fiscal year end 09/26) made **18 filings** in the window, spanning **2026-09-17 to 2026-10-08**. All 18 are insider-related: **14 Forms 4** (Section 16 statements of changes in beneficial ownership) and **4 Forms 144** (notices of proposed sale under Securities Act Rule 144). No periodic or current reports (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) appear in the index for this window.

Of these, **3 documents were read in full**, **9 routine forms were parsed** from their structured fields, and **6 filings were not fetched** and are described here only from index facts.

The single most consequential item is the **October 1, 2026 settlement of a performance-based RSU award granted October 1, 2023**, disclosed in Timothy D. Cook's Form 4 [2] and Deirdre O'Brien's Form 4 [3]. Those filings state that Apple's total shareholder return for the three-year performance period was **90.67%**, ranking **115 of the 480 companies** in the S&P 500 for the period - the **76.20th percentile** - and that this determined the payout percentage applied to each target award [2][3]. This is a disclosed company-level performance metric, not merely an ownership change.

---

## WHAT WAS FILED

**Forms 4 - Section 16 insider transaction reports (14 filings).**
Filed 2026-10-08 (period 10/06) [1]; 2026-10-05 (period 10/01), four separate filings [2][3][4][5]; 2026-10-01 (period 09/29) [9]; 2026-09-29 (period 09/27), six separate filings [10][11][12][13][14][15]; 2026-09-24 (period 09/22) [16]; and 2026-09-17 (period 09/15) [18]. The 09/29 cluster [14][15] and the filings dated 2026-09-24 [16] and 2026-09-17 [18] were **not fetched**; nothing beyond form type, filing date and period is known about them.

**Forms 144 - notices of proposed sale under Rule 144 (4 filings).**
Three were filed 2026-10-02 [6][7][8] and one 2026-09-22 [17]. Two of the October 2 notices were parsed [7][8]; the third 2026-10-02 notice [6] and the 2026-09-22 notice [17] were **not fetched**.

---

## WHAT THE DOCUMENTS SAY

### Timothy D. Cook: Form 4 filed 2026-10-05 [2]
Cook is reported as both a **Director and Officer, with the title "Executive Chair"** [2]. On 10/01/2026, a code **M** transaction settled **374,541 RSUs** into common stock, leaving 3,654,959 shares beneficially owned; shares are held through Mr. Cook's trust [2]. Apple then withheld **199,038 shares at $330.32** for tax withholding on vesting (code F), leaving 3,455,921 [2].

On 10/02/2026, four code **S** sales were reported, each a weighted-average price for multiple trades: 23,143 shares at $331.44 (range $330.66 - $331.655); 39,492 at $332.16 ($331.66 - $332.65); 88,239 at $333.26 ($332.66 - $333.655); and 40,879 at $333.94 ($333.66 - $334.50) [2]. The filing states these sales were made pursuant to a **Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted May 28, 2026** [2]. A **gift (code G) of 26,325 shares at $0** on 10/02/2026 brought reported holdings to **3,237,843 shares** [2].

The award terms as stated: granted **October 1, 2023** for a **target of 219,030 RSUs**, settling October 1, 2026 based on relative TSR versus the S&P 500 across Apple's fiscal 2024-2026 [2]. Apple's beginning TSR value was **$175.08** (average close of the first 20 trading days) and ending value **$333.82** (final 20 trading days) [2]. The vesting scale: 200% of target at or above the 85th percentile, 100% at or above the 55th, 25% at or above the 25th, 0% below the 25th, with straight-line interpolation between levels [2]. At the 76.20th percentile, **374,541 performance RSUs vested** [2].

### Deirdre O'Brien: Form 4 filed 2026-10-05 [3]
O'Brien is reported as an Officer, **Senior Vice President** [3]. On 10/01/2026, **99,878 RSUs** settled (code M), bringing holdings to 236,688; **53,489 shares at $330.32** were withheld for taxes, leaving 183,199 [3]. On 10/02/2026, two code S sales: **40,764 shares at a weighted-average $333.35** ($332.77 - $333.76) and **5,625 at $333.91** ($333.775 - $334.115), ending at **136,810 shares**, pursuant to a **Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted November 24, 2025** [3]. Her award was granted October 1, 2023 for a **target of 58,408 RSUs**, with the identical TSR mechanics, values and percentile cited above, yielding **99,878 RSUs vested** [3].

### Jennifer Newstead: Form 4 filed 2026-10-08 [1]
Newstead is reported as Officer, **SVP, GC and Government Affairs** [1]. A single code **S** sale of **2,399 shares at $332.01** on 10/06/2026 left **39,593 shares** held directly; the footnote cites a **Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted May 5, 2026** [1]. The form reports no derivative transactions [1].

### Routine forms parsed
**John Ternus (reported as director, CEO)** [4]: 99,878 RSUs settled 10/01/2026 (M), 49,054 shares withheld at $330.32 (F), then four 10/02 sales - 3,564 at $331.38, 5,348 at $332.26, 12,746 at $333.34, 3,754 at $334.05 - ending at **59,567 shares**, with footnotes citing a Rule 10b5-1 plan [4].

**Sabih Khan (COO)** [5]: 99,878 RSUs settled 10/01/2026; **52,854 shares withheld at $330.32**, leaving **1,120,919 shares**; no sales reported on that form [5].

**Jennifer Newstead** [9]: sale of 2,399 shares at $336.18 on 09/29/2026, 41,992 held after, under a Rule 10b5-1 plan [9].

**RSU grants dated 09/27/2026** [10][11][12][13]: Khan, Newstead, O'Brien and **Kevan Parekh (SVP, CFO)** each received **two awards of 47,645 RSUs** (each on 47,645 common shares), with no non-derivative transactions reported on those forms [10][11][12][13].

**Forms 144 parsed.** Cook proposes to sell **218,078 shares** on or about 10/02/2026 on Nasdaq through Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC (245 Summer Street, Boston MA), shares acquired via RSU vesting from Apple, under a **10b5-1 plan adopted 05/27/2026**; aggregate market value is stated as **$3,329,584** and units outstanding as **14,594,180,000** [7]. O'Brien proposes to sell **46,389 shares** on or about 10/02/2026 on Nasdaq through UBS Financial Services Inc. (11 Madison Avenue, New York NY), acquired by vesting of a stock award, under a **10b5-1 plan adopted 11/24/2025**; aggregate market value **$15,459,598.14**, units outstanding **1,459,418,000** [8]. Readers should note these two notices' stated value and share-count fields are internally inconsistent with each other and should be verified against the filings themselves.

---

## WHAT CHANGED

Period-over-period comparison is limited to what the documents make explicit. The Forms 4 are inherently comparative in one respect: each reports beneficial ownership **following** each transaction, so the running balances above are stated changes in holdings - Cook from 3,654,959 down to 3,237,843 shares across 10/01-10/02 [2]; O'Brien from 236,688 to 136,810 [3]; Newstead to 39,593 after the 10/06 sale [1], versus 41,992 after her 09/29 sale [9]; Ternus to 59,567 [4]; Khan to 1,120,919 [5].

The Cook and O'Brien Forms 4 also make an explicit award-versus-target comparison: payout was measured against the October 1, 2023 target grants of 219,030 and 58,408 RSUs respectively, with Apple's 76.20th-percentile TSR ranking determining the settled amounts of 374,541 and 99,878 RSUs [2][3].

Beyond these, **the documents read here do not compare fiscal periods** and contain no revenue, earnings, segment or guidance figures. No amendments or restatements appear in the index for this window. No comparison to prior-period operating results has been computed, because none of this material supplies one.

---

## WHAT TO WATCH

- **The six filings not fetched** - Forms 4 of 2026-09-29 (0001140361-26-038022; 0001140361-26-038021), 2026-09-24 (0001140361-26-037584) and 2026-09-17 (0001140361-26-037020), and Forms 144 of 2026-10-02 (0001958244-26-000636) and 2026-09-22 (0001950047-26-009738) - can be read directly on EDGAR to identify the insiders and transactions involved.
- **Whether the proposed sales in the Forms 144 are subsequently reported on Forms 4**, and whether the share counts match the 218,078 and 46,389 figures noticed [7][8] against the executed sales reported by Cook [2] and O'Brien [3].
- **Vesting of the two 47,645-RSU awards dated 09/27/2026** to Khan, Newstead, O'Brien and Parekh [10][11][12][13] - future Forms 4 should disclose settlement dates, any performance conditions and withholding.
- **Continued activity under the named Rule 10b5-1 plans**: Cook's plan adopted 05/28/2026 [2] (and the 05/27/2026 plan cited in his Form 144 [7]), O'Brien's 11/24/2025 plan [3][8], Newstead's 05/05/2026 plan [1], and the unnamed plan footnoted in Ternus's filing [4].
- **Apple's next periodic report**, which the index shows was not filed in this window, for the operating and fiscal-period detail absent from these ownership forms.
- **The role designations themselves**, which differ across forms in this set - Cook as Director and "Executive Chair" [2], Ternus as director and CEO [4], Khan as COO [5] - and which can be checked against future Section 16 filings and proxy materials.

---

*This report summarizes public SEC filings by Apple Inc. and its insiders in the stated window. It is not investment advice, not a recommendation, and contains no valuation opinion. Figures, dates, parties and terms are as stated in the cited filings; the six filings identified as not fetched have not been reviewed.*
